title: Dhātu
text: 1-8 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave pathavīdhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti || pe || || Yo āpodhātuyā || || Yo tejodhātuyā || || Yo vāyodhātuyā || Yo ākāsadhātuyā || Yo viññāṇadhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti || pe || jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || 9-14 Yo ca kho bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo || pe || || Yo viññāṇadhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo || pe || jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
